name: Bizjothjah
overview: Bizjothjah is identified in Scripture as a town within the territory of Judah, mentioned alongside other towns such as Hazarshual and Beersheba (Joshua 15:28). The town is also known by several related names including Balah, Baalath-Beer, and Bizjothjah-baalah, reflecting its historical and geographical significance within the tribal allotments (Joshua 19:3, 19:8). These multiple names highlight the town's place in the inheritance of the tribes of Israel, particularly within the context of the southern regions.
